_readme: Quests for the notice boards (#27). Edit freely while the game runs: it is read again a second after you save (or press F10).
type: fetch (bring count of item to the board) or find (a rare item is hidden within 40 m of the board: bring it back).
item, reward: item names from the item table (Stick, Stone, Berry, Mushroom, Shell, Fish, Coin, Key). count: how many to bring. rewardCount: how many of reward are paid.
text slots: {item}, {count}, {town} (the settlement), {place} (the notice board in {town}).
Each board shows one or two quests picked by its town's index, so adding or reordering quests changes what the boards offer.

quests.text: The smithy in {town} needs {count} sticks for the forge. Bring them to {place}.
{town} is short of berries: {count} to {place}, please.
A wall in {town} needs mending: bring {count} stones to {place}.
Someone in {town} lost a key not far from the board. Find it and bring it back.
A child in {town} dropped a lucky shell nearby. Find the shell and bring it to {place}.
